title: The Traffic Jam
philosophicalAnchor: A narrow bridge needs a traffic light. Without coordination, cars crash or deadlock. With proper synchronization, order emerges from chaos. But too many locks bring gridlock; too few bring collision.
pythonConcept: threading, Lock, RLock, deadlock, race condition, critical section, queue.Queue, Semaphore, synchronization
briefDescription: Build a thread-safe URL queue for a web crawler using Python's threading module, preventing race conditions and deadlocks.
theoryPillar: Race conditions occur when threads access shared state simultaneously. Critical sections must be protected by locks. Deadlock occurs when threads hold locks while waiting for each other in circular dependency.
anchorPillar: The one-lane bridge metaphor: without traffic light (lock), cars crash (data corruption), no one moves (deadlock), some push through (race conditions). With lock, one direction goes, others wait.
triggerPillar: UnsafeURLQueue with 10 threads: two threads add same URL (duplicates), one reads while another modifies (IndexError), list grows without bound. Thread-safe synchronization is essential.
realityPillar: threading.Lock provides mutual exclusion. with lock: ensures release on exit. Four conditions for deadlock: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, circular wait. Break any to prevent. queue.Queue is thread-safe internally.
